title: Adaptive surrogate modeling for high-dimensional spatio-temporal output
abstract: arXiv:2608.17250v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper develops an adaptive surrogate modeling method for problems with very high-dimensional spatio-temporal outputs. The analysis of spatio-temporal multi-physics systems is computationally expensive and consists of a large number of inputs and outputs. Surrogate models are often constructed to replace the physics-based model to achieve computational efficiency in analyses such as uncertainty quantification and optimization that require many function calls. In order to address the challenge introduced by the high dimensionality of spatio-temporal output, a dimension reduction method is first employed to map the high-dimensional output to a low-dimensional latent space. This is followed by the construction of the surrogate model in the low-dimensional space. translated_title: 自适应代理建模用于高维时空输出
translated_abstract: 本文开发了一种针对具有极高维时空输出问题的自适应代理建模方法。时空多物理系统的分析计算成本高昂，且包含大量输入和输出。代理模型通常被构建以替代基于物理的模型，从而在需要多次函数调用的分析（如不确定性量化和优化）中实现计算效率。为应对时空输出高维性带来的挑战，首先采用降维方法将高维输出映射到低维潜在空间，然后在低维空间中构建代理模型。原始空间中的预测误差（包括重建误差和代理模型误差）使用不同误差指标进行评估。基于预测误差的评估，自适应地选择新的训练样本点以改进模型性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一种自适应代理建模方法，通过降维和误差驱动的样本选择，高效处理高维时空输出问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an adaptive surrogate modeling method that efficiently handles high-dimensional spatio-temporal outputs via dimension reduction and error-driven sample selection.
